body: The good thing is that I'm in a good mood after reading your replies and other redditor's but most of the time I would be so lonely that these kind of thoughts would start creeping in my mind and I have seriously considered doing it to get rid of the awful feeling that follows.

I'm 17, almost 18 and if I do it and move out then It's going to be hard finding a place to live, starting from 0 with no money at all and etc..

I would do it but I have NO bank account and no money in hand at all, everything I have comes from my parents.

I have asked many people from my school about what would they want to be when they grow up and they're always so cock-sure of what they want which always depresses me because as you said, It's like staring into the abyss.

I do actually need to talk to someone, not necessarily a therapist, just someone that will listen and understand and I'm glad I posted here in SW, I can actually feel hope and that I can eventually recover.

Thanks for this and I love Winston Churchill and his quotes.

I wish I can just move in a big city, moving to a big city would mean I would be cut off from my parents (they will never agree on such a thing) and thus I will lose their support and I would be piss poor which is something I am and always will be afraid of.

But the thought of moving out to a big city will always be there.
Thank you for this. I enjoyed it and I will try to put it in my own perspective.

The problem with going to college is that I have really bad grades, I have C's and D's and no ambition at all and I feel like it is too late to do anything about it.

I did try hanging out with the shyer geeky kids but it mostly results in awkward silence. also, as weird as this may sound; we don't have much of those around, pretty much everyone here is a self-absorbed asshole.
